name: Pure PGN Viewer
author: busiesta

sections.description:
The Pure PGN Viewer is a lightweight Gutenberg block designed for chess bloggers.

Third-Party Resources

This plugin bundles the following libraries. Human-readable source code is available here:

  • Chessboard.js v1.0.0: https://github.com/oakmac/chessboardjs (License: MIT)
  • Chess.js v0.10.3: https://github.com/jhlywa/chess.js (License: BSD-3-Clause)
  • Stockfish.js: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js (License: GPLv3)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.9.9

  • Removed all inline and tags; moved to wp_add_inline_script/style.
  • Replaced json_encode with wp_json_encode.
  • Added mandatory source links for all bundled libraries in readme and main file.
